diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a one-shot sequence (period 0) instead of a repeating cycle with period 3 MIN. The IR specifies a cycle that repeats the body indefinitely; the candidate executes the body once and terminates, causing the mismatch at 190000 ms where the IR expects the first cycle's 'siren.setsirenmode' action but the candidate has already finished.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period from 0 to 180000 (3 MIN) to enable repetition. Removed the trailing delay(3 MIN) from the script body as it is redundant when the cycle period handles the interval between iterations. The script now correctly repeats the 'call', 'delay', 'call' sequence every 3 minutes.
